Cash on Delivery · Nationwide

Policy

Shipping

We deliver nationwide across Pakistan. Most major cities receive orders within 2–4 business days; remote areas may take slightly longer.

Cash on Delivery is available on eligible orders. Bank transfer is also accepted — we'll share account details after you place your order if you choose that option.

You will receive order confirmation and courier updates via phone or WhatsApp. Please ensure your phone number and address are accurate at checkout.

Shipping charges (if any) are confirmed before dispatch based on city and order value.
